stem: What is the most likely reason the author includes this sweeping generalization in the selection?
instruction:
Read this quotation from paragraph 8.

Audiobooks are able to do this while allowing the "reader" a great deal of enjoyment in the process.

options.label: A
options.text: To remind the reader of how audiobooks are similar to printed materials

options.label: B
options.text: To convince the reader to choose carefully when selecting an audiobook

options.label: C
options.text: To remind the reader that there are different kinds of audiobooks

options.label: D
options.text: To convince the reader that audiobooks are an appealing option

visual_elements: Audiobooks are able to do this while allowing the "reader" a great deal of enjoyment in the process.
